description: Camfrog direct messages (the contact-list inbox, not room PMs): a content-free activity ping, then an on-demand read of the inbox.
grounding: v1 memory camfrog-dms + pepe_dm.py: s2c 0x57 carries ids + a timestamp and no sender or text (and may re-fire on reconnect). The inbox ('Conversations' window) is a Chromium view with no native text, so v1 screenshots it with PrintWindow and reads it with a vision model. The DM web API is deliberately not used. Replying is not built.

frames.note: Read from pixels: names are what the inbox shows (often display names), so user.id may be missing and confidence is < 1.
